Pandora reports 6% Q3 organic growth and an EBIT margin of 15.9%, matching last year's organic growth rate. The margin rose 190bp, with 370bp from a one-off US tariff refund; Pandora calls the rest of the move broadly flat. 2026 guidance narrows to 2-3% organic growth and a 22.5-23% EBIT margin, both up from wider ranges. Full story on caratcapital.org, link in bio.

Royal Gold repaid $1.225bn of acquisition debt in about a year, beating its own two-year plan. Q3 revenue rose 84% to $464.8m and operating cash flow hit a record $344.4m, but the year-ago quarter came before its Sandstorm and Horizon deal closed in October 2025. Gold averaged $4,262 an ounce in the quarter, EPS rose to $2.68 from $1.92, and the company raised its other-metals revenue guidance to $53m-$56m. Full story on caratcapital.org, link in bio.
